messages:
Ravi: Quick follow-up on the auth outage postmortem. We have open items for customer comms, RCA sharing policy, and recurrence tagging. Need owners + deadlines.
Nina: I can draft the external note. Short, plain language. First pass by 16:00 PT.
Ethan: I'll own the recurrence analysis and tag backfill. Target: Friday COB.
LegalBot: Note: summary RCA ok to share on request. Internal logs need account-holder approval.
Ravi: Assignments: Nina 1? external note by 16:00, Ethan 1? recurring analysis by Fri COB, Legal to provide opt-in language by tomorrow 10:00. Will consolidate in the action tracker.
Nina: Draft external copy: 
"We experienced elevated authentication errors from 2026-03-12 08:1008:45 UTC affecting a subset of customers. Cause confirmed: memory growth in the authentication worker increased retries. We deployed a fix and verified recovery. We will email impacted accounts and post details on the status page. Customers may request a summary RCA."
Ethan: Adding instrumentation + mitigation suggestions to the recurrence doc. Will backfill related incidents over 90 days.
Ravi: Thanks, team. I'll ping Product and CS for final review and then publish the note once Nina updates with status page link.
